critical_code_review_comments: MatchEmailIn.email uses str (not EmailStr) — validation is done via _EMAIL_RE which is fine but pydantic EmailStr would be more idiomatic; current approach still correctly returns 422.
email_match_report returns {sent: True} even if downstream send_email fails silently (fire-and-forget). Consider awaiting result and reflecting actual send status.
Rate limit key uses request.client.host — behind ingress this is likely the proxy IP; consider X-Forwarded-For. This can group all users behind same egress and cause false 429s.
AiMatch.jsx sendReport treats all axios errors identically — 429 rate limit and 422 validation both show generic 'Could not send the report.' A distinct message for 429 would help UX.
server.py now 1050 lines — still >700; router split (auth/admin/leads/email/ai) recommended in follow-up.
